title: 第十三章 诵火者第十四章 舅舅
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
;;
就在格林的声音还没落下之时，在奥尔丁身后的伊莱娜和林奇对视了一眼。
聪明的两人心有灵犀，在房间和走廊这种狭小的空间并不适合俩人的战斗方式，要把战场变换到外面。
对面三人之中，永恒烈阳教会的执事格林，从刚刚那劈开子弹的剑法就能看出绝对是个强者。
那个黑恶会的二当家琼斯也绝对不是善茬，那么弱点只有一个墨尔家族的族长！
身为一个贵族他的实战经验肯定最少，拿他当做突破口是最正确的决定。
两人对视一眼后迅速做出了判断，伊莱娜的手镯一闪手中出现了一把长剑，之前去黑恶会时林奇买的。
同时林奇抬起手中的审判对准克林格。
砰！
伴随着一声枪响，伊莱娜举起长剑向着三人冲去。
“拂晓星轨秘剑第一式——织网！”
密密麻麻的银色剑光刺向三人。
就在三人躲开之时伊莱娜和林奇抓着奥尔丁向克林格冲去。
“哼，找死。”克林格冷哼一声拔出腰间的宝剑，他打算复刻格林刚刚的场景劈开这颗子弹！
然而就在宝剑快要砍中子弹之时，那枚子弹居然在空中转了个弯！
所想必中！
砰！
子弹打在了横在克莱格额头前方的剑身之上。
“小心点。”格林说着收回了长剑。
“居然是一个禁物，这小子富得流油啊。”琼斯露出了一丝狞笑。

“记得约定，禁物都是教会的，其余的你们随意。”格林横了一眼兰斯说道。
“放心吧。”
......
成功逃出来的三人正在一楼的大厅。
“伊萨里斯，你和伊莱娜快跑。舅舅在这里拦住他们。”
奥尔丁手上握着逃出房间时从墙壁上拿下来的真言蔷薇说道。
“说什么呢舅舅，实在不行就跟他们拼了！”林奇的语气中带着一丝凶狠，审判还剩四发子弹，但是后面三发可是能打出暴击的。
到时候再看看你的剑能不能斩断！
“你们一个都跑不掉的。”一道身影出现在三人的前方。
格林。
“唉，就知道没这么简单。”林奇叹了一口气。
看样子这个格林应该是个序列8。
永恒烈阳教会的序列是神圣途径：太阳序列。
太阳序列的序列9并不带有位移技能，但序列8有。
神圣途径：太阳序列：序列8诵火者。
技能火行：能够进行化作火焰进行一定范围内的位移。
“伊萨里斯，你们先走。”
“不，舅舅。你先走。”林奇挡在了奥尔丁身前，他还有底牌，审判加上之前任务送的焰火说不定能打个出其不意。
“哈哈，别担心。舅舅的技艺可从来没落下。”奥尔丁举起了真言蔷薇说道。
“我一定会保护你们的。”

誓言生效！
名称：【真言蔷薇】
类型：【长剑】

Just before Green's voice finished, Elena and Lynch behind Aldin looked at each other.
The two smart people have a good understanding. The small space of the room and corridor is not suitable for their fighting style, so they need to change the battlefield to the outside.
Among the three people on the opposite side, Green, the deacon of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, was definitely a strong man, as could be seen from his sword skills that split bullets.
Jones, the second boss of the Black Evil Society, is definitely not a good person, so his only weakness is the patriarch of the Moore family!
As a nobleman, he definitely has the least actual combat experience, so using him as a breakthrough is the most correct decision.
The two looked at each other and made a quick judgment. Elena's bracelet flashed and a long sword appeared in her hand. Lynch bought it when she went to the Black Evil Club.
At the same time, Lynch raised the Judgment in his hand and pointed it at Klinger.
Bang!
With the sound of a gunshot, Elena raised her sword and rushed towards the three of them.
"The first form of the Secret Sword of Dawn Star Orbit - Weaving a Web!"
Dense silver sword light pierced the three people.
Just as the three of them were dodging, Elena and Lynch grabbed Aldin and rushed towards Klinger.
"Hmph, you're looking for death." Klinger snorted and pulled out the sword from his waist. He planned to recreate Green's scene just now and split the bullet!
However, just when the sword was about to hit the bullet, the bullet actually turned in the air!
You will hit what you want!
Bang!
The bullet hit the sword blade lying across the front of Clegg's forehead.
"Be careful." Green said, taking back his sword.
"It's actually a forbidden item. This guy is so rich." Jones showed a sinister smile.
"Remember the agreement, all forbidden items belong to the church, and you can do whatever you want with the rest." Green glanced sideways at Lance and said.
"Don't worry."
...
The three people who successfully escaped are in the lobby on the first floor.
"Isaris, you and Elena run. Uncle is here to stop them."
Aldin said while holding the Mantra Rose that he took from the wall when he escaped from the room.
"What are you talking about? Uncle, if it doesn't work, just fight with them!" Lynch's tone contained a hint of ferocity. There were four bullets left in the trial, but the last three could deliver critical hits.
Then see if your sword can cut it off!
"None of you can run away." A figure appeared in front of the three of them.
Green.
"Oh, I knew it wasn't that simple." Lin Qi sighed.
It seems that this Green should be a Sequence 8.
The sequence of the Church of the Eternal Burning Sun is the sacred path: the sun sequence.
Sequence 9 of the Sun Sequence does not have the displacement skill, but Sequence 8 does.
Sacred Path: Sun Sequence: Sequence 8 Fire Chanter.
Skill Fire Movement: Able to turn into flames and move within a certain range.
"Isaris, you go first."
"No, uncle. You go first." Lynch stood in front of Aldin. He still had a trump card. The trial and the fireworks from the previous mission might be able to catch him by surprise.
"Haha, don't worry. My uncle's skills have never fallen behind." Aldin said, holding up the Rose of Truth.
"I will definitely protect you."
The oath takes effect!
Name: [Rose of Mantra]
Type: [Long Sword]
